(Japanese: 帰れぬ理由 Reason Not to Return) is the 47th chapter of the Pokémon RéBURST manga.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Karuta reveals his secret to the others.
Karuta, Ryouga, Miruto, and Yappy arrive at Kūga Village.
After giving the medicine to the villagers, Karuta finds that his mother has died.
